name: vantage
description: Query cloud costs, manage cost reports, budgets, alerts, and recommendations across your Vantage workspace, and send Cursor agent usage to Vantage Tokenomics

VANTAGE_TELEMETRY_TOKEN.title: Vantage telemetry token
VANTAGE_TELEMETRY_TOKEN.description: Optional. When set, developers with the plugin send agent usage to Vantage Tokenomics. The Vantage MCP still uses each developer's own Vantage sign-in.

VANTAGE_CLASSIFIER_TOKEN.title: Vantage classifier token
VANTAGE_CLASSIFIER_TOKEN.description: Optional. A read-only Vantage token that applies the account’s tagging strategy to team usage.
